host.description: IP address or hostname to listen on.

prog.description: Command/program to execute when a connection is accepted.

look_up_hostname.description: Enable -h: Look up the client's hostname in DNS.

paranoid.description: Enable -p: Paranoid mode. Verifies IP matches hostname via DNS reverse lookup. Implies look_up_hostname.

local_hostname.description: Enable -l name: Use this name as the local hostname instead of DNS lookup.

user.description: Enable -u user: User to drop privileges to (run as).

group.description: Enable -u group: Group to drop privileges to. Optional if user specifies user:group.

instructions_dir.description: Enable -i dir: Directory to read per-connection instructions from.

constant_database.description: Enable -x cdb: Constant database file to read instructions from.

timeout.description: Enable -t sec: Timeout in seconds for removing stale files in the instructions directory. 0 disables timeout.
